description: Render a JTD to PNG with the app's REAL engine (full fidelity; only needed to check skins and effects), and measure it: nodes that overlap and labels cut short with an ellipsis, read from the engine — the defects that are easy to miss when looking at the image. Requires a checkout of the repo AND a running dev server. For everything else use diagram_svg, which needs neither.

measure.description: Also return overlapping nodes and truncated labels (and every node box, in a JSON next to the image)

out.description: Output path: .png (default, full fidelity) or .svg for a vector image (no skins, images or icon glyphs). Default: a temp PNG

name: diagram_render
